description: Render markdown as an A4 PDF. The PDF comes back inside this result as an embedded application/pdf resource (base64); nothing is stored and there is no download link. If you can run shell commands, save the file directly instead: curl -sS -X POST https://md2pdf.free/api/pdf -H "Content-Type: text/markdown" --data-binary @document.md -o document.pdf

letterhead.description: Name in the formal style's letterhead band, e.g. a company name. Defaults to the document title.

markdown.description: The full markdown document. Start with "# Title": it names the file.

style.description: classic (default), modern or formal. Overrides any <!-- md2sign:style=... --> line.

name: render_pdf
title: Make a PDF
